requirement: Parse webhook JSON into one of three event models chosen by the kind tag, reporting tag problems and field problems precisely, forbidding extra fields and mutation, and compute net revenue from captured and refunded payments.
skeleton: A frozen extra-forbid base model, three Literal-tagged event models, a TypeAdapter over an Annotated union with a kind discriminator, parse_event with validate_json, and net_revenue summing by isinstance.
caption: Webhook events validated with pydantic v2 as a discriminated union. A private base model sets ConfigDict with extra forbid and frozen, and requires a non-empty id. PaymentSucceeded has kind Literal payment.succeeded, amount_cents constrained by Field gt=0 and currency limited to usd or eur. PaymentRefunded has kind payment.refunded, a positive amount_cents and reason defaulting to requested_by_customer. CustomerDeleted has kind customer.deleted and a non-empty customer_id. A module-level TypeAdapter wraps Annotated of the three-model union with Field discriminator kind, so pydantic reads the kind tag first and validates only the matching model. parse_event(payload) calls validate_json on the raw bytes and raises pydantic.ValidationError: union_tag_invalid for an unknown kind, union_tag_not_found when kind is missing, and a single error located under the tag for a bad field. net_revenue(payloads) parses each body, adds captured cents, subtracts refunded cents and ignores other events. The fixture asserts the parsed model types, the default refund reason, the tag error types, that an extra field on a refund yields exactly one extra_forbidden error at payment.refunded then customer_id, that zero and negative amounts raise ValidationError, that assigning to a parsed event raises ValidationError, and that 1000 captured minus 250 refunded is 750.

constraints: The kind tag selects exactly one model to validate
Unknown or missing kinds raise ValidationError with a tag error

rationale.teaches: Field(discriminator=...) on an Annotated union through TypeAdapter, which dispatches on the tag instead of trying every member.
rationale.why: A plain union still accepts valid payloads, so tests that only check the happy path miss the vague, multiplied errors and the wrong-model matches it produces.

ops.docstring: Validate webhook events whose shape is chosen by their kind tag.

ops.stmt: from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, TypeAdapter

ops.source:
class PaymentSucceeded(_Event):
    """A captured payment."""

    kind: Literal["payment.succeeded"]
    amount_cents: int = Field(gt=0)
    currency: Literal["usd", "eur"]

class PaymentRefunded(_Event):
    """Money returned to the customer."""

    kind: Literal["payment.refunded"]
    amount_cents: int = Field(gt=0)
    reason: str = "requested_by_customer"

class CustomerDeleted(_Event):
    """A customer removed from the account."""

    kind: Literal["customer.deleted"]
    customer_id: str = Field(min_length=1)

candidates.why_wrong: A plain union tries every model, so errors are multiplied and no tag errors are reported.
ge=0 accepts a captured payment of zero cents.
Without extra forbid, unknown fields are silently ignored instead of rejected.
Refunds are added to revenue instead of subtracted from it.
Dropping frozen leaves parsed events mutable after validation.
